title: Is the demand for games still good or bad?
author: Such_Mulberry2517
selftext:
Year a go nov2025 i started to learn unity and i was inspried by so many devs. It made me come to the decision, releasing my own game on steam, a year after i released my first game on steam "Whitopia", a game where you have to paint everything you see white.

I made this game in order to learn the process of being a solodev and understanding my weekness and what i can do well, potenially partenting with someone where this person can fill my gaps.

  
In the last year, AI has been going crazy like hell and we are whitensing alot of changes in the market and the capbablities of AI.

  
Do you still think, the market is still be the same?

lets ignore the amount of games going into steam and focus on the demand.

Questions: 

1. **Demand still there or no?** 
2. **Is the focus nowdays is shifting into "Game design, ideas and fantasy" more than any other skills in making games?**
